subject: Request: approval for Skybridge AI reference + logo usage
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ellis Porter <ellis.porter@skybridge.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: approval for Skybridge AI reference + logo usage

Hi Ellis —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. As discussed, we'd love to publish a short customer highlight and include the Skybridge logo on our website and a one-page case excerpt. Drafts and the proposed logo lockup are attached.

What we'd like from you:
- Permission to use the Skybridge AI name + logo on our marketing site and in a downloadable one-pager
- A short quote (1–2 sentences) we can attribute to a Skybridge contact — feel free to edit our suggested line in the draft
- Any legal or brand constraints we should follow (link to your brand guidelines if available)

Attachments: [Attachment: skybridge-case-draft-v1.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: redwood-logo-guidelines.png (PNG)]

Timeline: if possible, could we get sign-off by end of next week (Sept 15)? We can push to a later date if your legal needs more time.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

—Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
From: Ellis Porter <ellis.porter@skybridge.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Skybridge Legal <legal@skybridge.ai>
Date: 2027-09-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: approval for Skybridge AI reference + logo usage

Hi Lauren —

Appreciate the draft — this looks good. I'm looping in our legal team (cc'd) to confirm brand and compliance items, and our comms lead will review the quote. A couple quick notes from my side:
- Please keep the technology details high-level (we can't disclose internal metrics).
- Prefer the quote to reference business impact (time-to-market, cost savings) rather than internal architecture.

Legal, can you review the attached and confirm if an executed logo consent is required (we typically need a signed usage form)?

Thanks,
Ellis Porter
Head of Partnerships, Skybridge AI
ellis.porter@skybridge.ai | +1 212-555-0108
From: Skybridge Legal <legal@skybridge.ai>
To: Ellis Porter <ellis.porter@skybridge.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-07T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: approval for Skybridge AI reference + logo usage

On Tue, Sep 7, 2027 at 11:03 AM Ellis Porter <ellis.porter@skybridge.ai> wrote:
> Appreciate the draft — this looks good. I'm looping in our legal team (cc'd) to confirm brand and compliance items...

Hi all —

We reviewed the draft. High level: we are OK to proceed with a short customer highlight and logo usage, subject to the following conditions:
1) We need an executed logo usage consent form signed by both parties. I've attached our standard consent template — please confirm if Redwood uses its own form or if you can sign ours.
2) No specific performance numbers (percentages, latency figures, cost per token) can appear in public materials without separate approval.

If you can return a signed consent (PDF or DocuSign), we can provide the official Skybridge logo files and a one-sentence approved quote.

Attachment: [Attachment: skybridge-executed-logo-consent.pdf (PDF) - placeholder, unsigned]

Regards,
Skybridge Legal Team
legal@skybridge.ai
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Skybridge Legal <legal@skybridge.ai>, Ellis Porter <ellis.porter@skybridge.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-08T08:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: approval for Skybridge AI reference + logo usage

Thanks for the quick review and the conditions.

We can sign your consent form — I attached the DocuSign link below so you can complete signature on your side; alternatively we can sign and return if you prefer a Redwood-signed PDF. We also confirm we will remove any specific performance figures from the public draft.

Proposed next steps:
- You sign the logo consent via DocuSign (link below) OR we sign and return (let us know)
- Skybridge to provide official logo assets once consent is executed
- We will share the final one-sentence quote for approval before publishing

DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/recipient/sign/EXAMPLE12345
Drive folder (current draft): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleDriveLink

If helpful, Vivek from our legal ops is available for a 20-min touchpoint — Vivek, any constraints on our side?

Best,
Lauren

—Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Skybridge Legal <legal@skybridge.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Ellis Porter <ellis.porter@skybridge.ai>
Date: 2027-09-08T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: approval for Skybridge AI reference + logo usage

Lauren / Ellis —

Thanks — we routed the DocuSign internally and the form was executed today. Attached is the signed consent (PDF). Two minor clarifications before you publish:
- Please use the horizontal logo lockup (not the stacked mark) — we'll send the official SVGs by end of day to the email on file.
- For the quote, please use the following approved sentence (verbatim):
"Redwood Inference helped us accelerate model deployment and reduced inference costs across key product lines."

Once you have the final one-pager with the approved quote and the logo, please send a final pre-publish copy to legal@skybridge.ai for a quick compliance check.

Attachment: [Attachment: skybridge-executed-logo-consent.pdf (PDF) - signed copy]

Regards,
Skybridge Legal Team
legal@skybridge.ai
